name: agentphone
description: Give Devin a real phone number to place and receive voice calls and texts, and follow a call's transcript while it is in progress
shortDescription: Phone calls and SMS for agents

setup.notice: Calls need an agent with a phone number attached, and the live-transcript skill reads the API key from the AGENTPHONE_API_KEY environment variable on Devin's machine, so also save the key as a secret with that name.
